name: Air-to-Water DIY Guide (Richard Wilson VSL)
product_description: A DIY guide and video presentation from a California farmer, Richard Wilson, on building a small home unit that condenses moisture from humid air into drinking water. The VSL tells his drought story and explains the condensation principle.
target_audience: US homeowners 40+ in drought-prone or storm-prone regions (Southwest, California, Texas, Gulf Coast); preppers, homesteaders and off-grid DIYers; people who follow water-shortage news.
key_benefits: A backup source of drinking water for droughts, storms and outages
Uses the same condensation principle as an air conditioner
A DIY project rather than an expensive commercial unit
Less reliance on stored or bottled water in an emergency
proof_points: Atmospheric water generation is an established technology
Air conditioners visibly produce condensate water on humid days
Lake Mead reached record lows in 2022
landing_page_copy: Free video presentation. A drought-hit farmer shows how he and an HVAC-tech friend built a unit that turns humid air into drinking water.
